description: A natural-language filter bar for the Svelte 5 data grid. Type EMEA active over 50k or sales rep starting with A younger than 35 and a rule-based parser maps the phrase to a chain of api.setFilter calls plus an optional api.setSort and a top-N slice, so it is fast, predictable and works offline. It understands over, less than, between, before, after, this month, quarter names, set-filter values, starting with, containing, sort by, highest, lowest and top N; unresolved tokens fall into a search filter, and the same token-to-intent shape is what you would hand to a model through setAIProvider.

faq.question: How does the parser pick a column?
faq.answer: Number and date phrases look for the nearest column of that type by name, set values such as EMEA or active are matched against the distinct values of the set-filter columns, and the rest becomes a search filter on the name-like columns.

faq.question: Can I see what it decided?
faq.answer: Yes. The bar shows the parsed filters, the sort and the top N as chips with a plain-English explanation before Apply is clicked, and Clear resets the grid and the phrase.

faq.question: Why rule-based rather than a model?
faq.answer: It answers instantly, needs no key and behaves the same every time, which matters for a filter bar. The parsed shape is identical to what the AI helpers return, so swapping in a model is a matter of replacing the parser body.
